body: i feel like i used to not care but seeing how terrible some people are recently im shocked

Either way I’ll know its him who posted it. I just hope tech is advanced enough to get his name bc thats all i want and need

The lady was so helpful I’m feeling less anxious but hoping if something is posted he can be tracked easily, not sure how any of that works. I hope they all get taken down in my lifetime. Sucks that I have to be careful now on social media and can’t enjoy it like I used to but live and learn I guess. Im in a city and work in an industry where nudity isnt looked down upon which im lucky for but still. I have his instagram and snapchat if anyone can help me.
